title: Control one continuous-construction task loop through ARE and C19
outcome: Provide one Project-owned, no-effect task-loop capability that composes the accepted ARE Codex host boundary with the C19 continuous-construction evaluator so only one exact next D65 stage may continue automatically, real blockers stop, and human testing plus terminal confirmation remain distinct immutable gates.
rationale: ARE already mediates Codex preflight, effects, turn completion, and bounded continuation, while C19 already evaluates exact D65 attempt evidence. A separate composition capability can close the task loop without allowing either runtime, the first Craft ORODI consumer, or agent prose to absorb the other's meaning or manufacture authority.
scope: one immutable composition Product Capability owned by the Agent Reasoning Engine Project
one capability-local business ontology for turn evidence, D65 attempts, C19 evaluations, composed decisions, exact successors, human-test packets, observations, and terminal decisions
one DomainSpec-v2 authored source with deterministic graph and system-ontology projections
one offline L0 adapter proving the C19 CONTINUE and ARE direct and exact-next-stage conjunction
one successor exact implementation binding and collect-all candidate conformance assessment after implementation bytes freeze
exclusions: changing accepted ARE implementation binding 002 or the C19 runtime and program
live proxy forwarding before the offline L0 decision matrix passes independently
treating Project creation, validation, compilation, tests, or receipts as capability adoption or ontology admission
default Codex installation, route activation, publication, release, deployment, credentials, destructive action, or external effects
owner_route: Agent Reasoning Engine Project owner plus CyberAlchemy v2 product owner plus Agent Reasoning Engine runtime owner plus CyberAlchemy v2 governance-model owner plus DomainSpec v2 language and compiler owners

success_conditions.statement: The Project and Goal close bidirectionally around the selected composition capability identity.
success_conditions.evidence_requirement: Project and Goal validate, appear in the Goal ontology view, and preserve authority_effect none.

success_conditions.statement: The composition capability crosses the complete authored D65 predecessor chain before an implementation binding claim.
success_conditions.evidence_requirement: Exact Project, Product Capability, business ontology, DomainSpec source, compiler, graph, and system-ontology identities and digests close deterministically.

success_conditions.statement: The offline adapter permits a successor only when C19 is CONTINUE, ARE is direct, and the successor names the exact first pending D65 stage.
success_conditions.evidence_requirement: Positive decision-matrix and hostile identity, ordering, timeout, malformed-result, and stage-mismatch tests pass with deterministic receipts.

success_conditions.statement: Human test readiness and terminal confirmation start no successor and authorize no effect.
success_conditions.evidence_requirement: Fixture and contract evidence preserve distinct packet, observation, and terminal-decision identities with authority and effect ceilings false.

evidence_requirements: Every cross-runtime input and output must carry exact identity and digest provenance.
The accepted ARE binding 002 and candidate C19 binding must remain byte-identical inputs rather than being silently rewritten.
Dependent checks must be reported not_evaluable when Project, capability, ontology, DomainSpec, implementation, or acceptance predecessors remain ungranted.
Any live proxy integration, installation, activation, publication, deployment, or external effect requires a separate exact owner decision.
target_horizon: first deterministic offline composition vertical before any live proxy integration

revision_history.change: Created the Project-owned task-loop Goal after the owner selected a new Agent Reasoning Engine Project and the composition Product Capability identity.
revision_history.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 product owner plus Agent Reasoning Engine Project owner

challenge_route: Challenge Project ownership through the Agent Reasoning Engine Project owner, product outcome through the CyberAlchemy v2 product owner, C19 semantics through the governance-model and Constitution owners, ARE host behavior through the Agent Reasoning Engine runtime owner, and DomainSpec construction claims through the DomainSpec v2 owners.
